inputs.description: The human's interview answers, gathered by the coordinating session and written to intake/answers.md. OPTIONAL: the PO drafts from the stated intent + the canon; a fresh project may have thin answers, and never invents beyond them.

outputs.description: The PO's project overview (product-overview.md), drafted from the human's answers + @ui-ux-design-principles framing.
The NFR brief (nfrs.md): ## Required R<n> items across the @software-design-principles categories, plus ## Preferences / ## Out of bounds.
The UX design brief (design/design-brief.md) , UI track only, so OPTIONAL (a backend-only project produces none).
